notes: type is 'level' (support/resistance; labels follow live spot) or 'liquidation_cluster' (a magnet, never support or resistance). 50-week and 200-week averages are computed live from price_history.json. Q15 and realized price are live from support_floors.json (the same Bitview / Check overlays as the chart). STH Q75/Q90 in Daily Levels come from bull_watch.json. Fixed thesis lines: $150k, $100k, $83k, $72k, $70k. June 30 low is a historical fact. The buyer cushion is a real level at $62,300–$64,200 (support / inside / resistance to reclaim follows live spot). Its BTC count comes from Bitview lin1000 buckets 62000 + 63000.
